reply_text:
I posted the list in #strategic-pod as a reply to your message. It has five tickets, each with its source. Two need checking before they go into Mateo's history:

- **#8841** is the conflict. Gideon says he closed it on Jul 1, but the Sep 30 digest says Mateo filed it and it was escalated to platform engineering. The May 4 digest also lists it as open, with a different site and description. It may have been reopened or the number reused.
- **PD-8841** (Apr 27 digest) may be the same ticket as #8841, or not. I flagged it as unclear.

The other three are PD-4418 (Sep 15 digest, a Dock Door 9 export issue; the digest doesn't name Vantorre, so that attribution is my inference), INC-4821 (Aug 3 Hartford thread, status-page access), and VT-55120 (Oct 14 Hartford thread, root cause of the kiosk outage).

I left out #4812 because the digest ties it to Vantorre Mobility. I read the digests directly and used only what this channel and the digests contain. I didn't use any DMs.
